standard-dialogue.npc: 'Ello, sugar. I'm afraid I can't gossip right now, I've got a cake in the oven.

attempting-to-take-the-nearby-chocolate-.npc: Oi you! Did you think I didn't see that? That's my chocolate bar, that is!

attempting-to-take-the-nearby-chocolate-.player: Oh, sorry. I didn't realise it belonged to anybody.

attempting-to-take-the-nearby-chocolate-.npc: That's alright, honey. You look a bit thin anyway. Take it if you need it.

using-nuff-s-certificate-on-her.text: You show the certificate to the Fairy chef.

using-nuff-s-certificate-on-her.player: Do you know what these strange marks mean?

using-nuff-s-certificate-on-her.npc: Sorry dearie, no, but I have seen a sign with similar marks near the mysterious ruins. You know, the ones that lead you to the Cosmic Rune Altar.
